title: CSI-CHAPTER

sections.heading: computer society of india
sections.content:
To bring about the technical development of students by organizing seminars, workshops and other activities.
To improve non-technical abilities of students by engendering good communication skills, managerial abilities, presentation skills and team work.
To act as a forum for students to voice their opinions and suggestions so as to contribute towards their social and technological development.
Head of Department: Prof. Manoj A. Mulik
CSI Branch Counselors : Prof. Rama Gaikwad
CSI Branch Coordinator : Prof. Vijayendra Gaikwad ; Prof. Amit Kadam ; Prof. Tejashree Gaikwad
